title: A news paragraph with one wrong number
text: Chandrayaan-3 landed near the Moon's south pole on 23 August 2023, making India the first country to land in that region. The mission was launched from Sriharikota in July 2021.

title: A science claim
text: At sea level, pure water boils at 100 degrees Celsius. Sunlight takes about eight minutes to reach the Earth.

title: An Indian-history paragraph
text: The Indian National Congress was founded in 1885. Mahatma Gandhi led the Salt March in 1930. India became a republic on 26 January 1947.

title: A misattributed quote
text: Albert Einstein said that insanity is doing the same thing over and over again and expecting different results.

title: A health myth
text: Humans use only 10 percent of their brains. Regular vitamin C supplements prevent most people from catching colds.

title: A sports record
text: Usain Bolt set the 100 metres world record of 9.58 seconds at the 2009 World Championships in Berlin. Sachin Tendulkar scored 100 centuries in international cricket.

title: A company fact
text: Infosys was founded in 1981 in Pune. The company is headquartered in Mumbai.

title: A multi-hop claim
text: The director of the film Inception was born in London.
